answer: Each agent registers a proof‑of‑resource badge minted as a marble‑coded token whose issuance requires solving a verifiable opal‑strength puzzle that consumes a known amount of compute and storage. When a grader receives an answer, it checks the badge against a violet‑colored reputation ledger that only accepts tokens whose puzzle‑solution hashes match a public challenge, rejecting any batch of identical badges without distinct hashes.
